#Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for Chief Engineer (CE)
[italic]Below outlines expectations and permissions granted to a CE given the current alert level:[/italic]
[bold][color=green] Code Green [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] The CE is responsible for ensuring the Anti-Matter Engine (AME) is constructed if available. After construction the CE must work with their department to activate a long-term power generator for station use.
[bold]2.[/bold] The CE is responsible for maintaining all power generators in active use on station. Neglecting this duty is grounds for termination if power fails on the station.
[bold]3.[/bold] The CE is responsible ensuring the proper setup, maintenance, and integrity of the Station's Atmospherics Distribution System. Failure to maintain its integrity is grounds for termination.
[bold]4.[/bold] The CE is responsible for maintaining the integrity of Telecommunications.
[bold]5.[/bold] The CE has the ability to label areas or departments as Condemned, given damage to the area cannot be repaired within a reasonable time-frame.
[bold][color=blue] Code Blue [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Green.
[bold][color=RED] Code Red [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Blue.
